project_type: pnpm monorepo: Express 5 + TypeScript (ESM) API in apps/api, React 19 + React Router 7 + Vite web app in apps/web, Prisma 7 + PostgreSQL
language: TypeScript (ESM with .js import specifiers on the API)
build_system: pnpm workspaces. API compiles with tsc; web builds with Vite. Prisma client is generated to apps/api/src/generated/prisma (NOT node_modules) — it MUST be regenerated after any schema.prisma change or the API will not typecheck. ESM: every relative import in apps/api uses a .js extension even though the source is .ts.
test_framework: NONE. apps/api test script is a stub ('echo "Error: no test specified" && exit 1'); apps/web has eslint only. There is no vitest/jest/cucumber. Do NOT assume a runtime test runner. Verification is: TypeScript compiler (tsc --noEmit), the build, prisma validate, and eslint for the web app.
build_command: From repo root c:\Qivo: `pnpm typecheck` (runs tsc --noEmit in apps/api then apps/web), `pnpm build:api` (tsc in apps/api), `pnpm build:web` (vite build in apps/web).
test_command: No automated tests. Use `pnpm typecheck` as the primary gate, plus `pnpm build:api` / `pnpm build:web`, `pnpm lint` (web eslint), and `pnpm db:generate` after schema edits. Per-app typecheck: `pnpm --filter api exec tsc --noEmit` and `pnpm --filter web exec tsc --noEmit`.
verification_instructions: 1) After editing prisma/schema.prisma, run `pnpm db:generate` and `pnpm --filter api exec prisma validate` — both must succeed before anything that imports the client will compile. 2) After API source edits, run `pnpm --filter api exec tsc --noEmit` then `pnpm build:api`. 3) After web edits, run `pnpm --filter web exec tsc --noEmit` and `pnpm lint`. 4) Final whole-project gate: `pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:api && pnpm build:web`. Migrations are applied with `pnpm db:migrate` (prisma migrate deploy) — do NOT run this against a shared/production DB during local verification; validating the schema + generate is sufficient to confirm the migration SQL is consistent with the model.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The Prisma client at apps/api/src/generated/prisma is generated (committed to the repo as the project already does) and MUST be regenerated with `pnpm db:generate` whenever prisma/schema.prisma changes. No other generated/snapshot files.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell shell. pnpm is the package manager (version pinned via devEngines). Never run `prisma migrate deploy` against production; the Railway plan/DB may be unavailable. Email sending requires RESEND_API_KEY — when unset, sendEmail() silently logs to console and never throws (this is the intended no-op path). Do not push commits.
contribution_requirements: No root AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md/.kiro steering exist. Follow the approved design at c:\Qivo\.agents\tasks\form-share-feature\design.md verbatim and the design-review.md. Error signalling convention: throw a plain Error whose .name is a known code string; apps/api/src/app.ts errorHandler switches on .name -> HTTP status + { success:false, error:{ code, message } } envelope. New .name values MUST be added to that switch (only SHARE_NOT_FOUND is new). Route handlers return { success:true, data:{...} }. Modules use the *.routes.ts / *.service.ts / *.schemas.ts triplet mirroring apps/api/src/modules/members.
key_patterns: Service layer throws tagged Errors; routes guard `if(!req.user) 401`, validate params are strings, `schema.parse(req.body)`, call service, wrap in {success:true,data}, `catch(e){next(e)}`. Fire-and-forget side effects use `void <promise>.catch(console.error)` (the design explicitly does NOT copy the members module's uncaught `void createNotification(...)` which lacks .catch). Tokens: `randomBytes(32).toString("hex")` (node:crypto), matching auth.service.ts. Emails via sendEmail() using layout()+button() helpers, reusing getWebUrl(). Prisma compound-unique accessor for @@unique([formId,email]) is `formId_email`. CSRF (csrf.ts) already exempts GET/HEAD/OPTIONS, /public/ paths, and Bearer requests — so GET /api/invites/:token and POST /api/invites/:token/accept need NO csrf.ts change. Web API client: api.get/post/patch/delete + publicGet (apps/web/src/lib/api.ts); ApiRequestError has a .code field. React routes use <Protected>{(user)=>...}</Protected> which wraps AuthGuard+AppLayout.
